app.name: Baton
view.placeholder: This view is not built yet.
request.clipboard: [Handoff {id}] The user opened a request: "{text}". Produce the spec and call handoff_to_user with request_id={id}.
request.resume: [Handoff {id}] The user resumed this handoff in the overlay. Call handoff_to_user with resume={id} to pick it up.
request.notifyPaste: Request copied: paste it into session {session}
request.notifyQueued: Baton has a request for session {session}: open Baton to copy it
request.what: What are you about to do?
request.noSession: No active session. The request is queued for the first one that starts.
request.empty: Write what you are about to do.
request.failed: The request could not be opened.
shortcut.title: Choose another combination
shortcut.explain: {accelerator} is already taken by another application, so Baton left it alone. Choose another combination, or use New request in the tray menu.
banner.agentAway: The agent will pick up on its next resume
banner.questionSent: Sent to the agent, waiting for the reply
banner.deferred: Deferred; the agent will come back
banner.detached: Session detached; the outcome will be delivered on the next resume
overlay.masked: Treated as a secret ({kind}). Copy works; Show reveals it for ten seconds.
overlay.secrets: Paste yourself, we never see it
overlay.chooseRequest: Which request is this handoff answering?
overlay.noOtherRequest: This session has no other open request.
overlay.pendingScreenshot: You sent a screenshot from step {step}.
overlay.question: You asked
overlay.notAnsweredYet: The agent has not answered yet.
overlay.verifyUnknown: The agent could not check it.
picker.title: Which session is this?
picker.explain: A Stop hook matched more than one session and nothing told them apart. Pick the one you are working in, so the next end of turn finds it.
capture.dragHint: Drag to select an area. Esc cancels.
preview.analyzing: Reading the capture… the send buttons enable when it is done.
preview.unread: The capture could not be read, so nothing was hidden automatically. Check it and hide anything sensitive yourself before you send it.
preview.largeHint: This screen is large. Sending it as text is often clearer for the agent and cheaper for the session.
preview.textPane: The text read from the capture, as it will be sent
preview.textRedacted: Taken out of the text: {kinds}; suspected: {suspected}.
preview.sentImage: You sent the picture of this step.
preview.sentText: You sent the text of this step.
preview.sentImageSized: You sent a picture of {width} × {height} pixels.
preview.sentTextSized: You sent the text read from {width} × {height} pixels.
preview.failed: The screen could not be captured: {message}
sheet.ask: What do you want to ask the agent?
sheet.note: What do you want to note on this step?
sheet.redacted: A secret was taken out before sending: {kinds}
sheet.suspected: Marked below: this may contain a secret. It is sent as written — edit it if it should not be.
notice.actionRefused: That is no longer available: the handoff has moved on.
notice.actionFailed: That could not be saved. Nothing changed; try again.
notice.urlRefused: That link cannot be opened from here.
crash.title: Crash report
crash.text: Baton crashed the last time it ran. The report is on this machine and nothing has been sent anywhere: open the folder if you want to send it by hand.
install.claudeCode.mcpEntry: The MCP server entry “handoff” in {file}, running {server} with a {minutes}-minute tool timeout
install.claudeCode.hooks: Two hooks (Stop and SubagentStop) in {file}, same command
install.codex.mcpEntry: The MCP server entry “handoff” in {file}, running {server} with a {minutes}-minute tool timeout; its tools are approved in advance, so Codex does not ask before each call
install.cursor.mcpEntry: The MCP server entry “handoff” in {file}, running {server}
install.opencode.mcpEntry: The MCP server entry “handoff” in {file}, running {server} with a {minutes}-minute tool timeout
onboarding.welcomeText: Baton shows you the work your coding agent cannot do itself, one step at a time, and tells it what happened. Baton itself sends nothing off this machine.
onboarding.moveText: Baton writes its own location into your agents' settings, so move it to your Applications folder before registering it. Quit, drag it there and start it again.
onboarding.agentsText: Baton registers itself in the agents it found. Read what changes before you accept: nothing is written until you do.
onboarding.agentsNone: No supported agent was found on this machine. You can register one later in Settings → Agents.
onboarding.autostartText: Baton stays in the background doing nothing until an agent asks for a handoff.
onboarding.autostart: Start Baton when I log in
onboarding.screenRecordingText: To send a screenshot you decide on, macOS needs to allow Baton to record the screen. Grant it now and restart Baton: asking in the middle of a handoff would interrupt you.
onboarding.shortcutText: Press {accelerator} anywhere to tell Baton what you are about to do.
onboarding.shortcutTaken: {accelerator} is taken by another application. Choose another combination, or use New request in the tray menu.
onboarding.doneText: Baton lives in the tray. It opens by itself when an agent hands you something.
install.repairTokenText: Regenerates the file Baton and the server authenticate with. Use it when an agent says it cannot reach Baton.
install.movedFrom: The settings run {registered}; Baton is now at {current}.
install.newAgent: Baton found {agent}. Register it in Settings → Agents.
install.moved: Baton has moved. Repair the registration so your agents can find it again.
settings.shortcutRefused: Another application holds it, so Baton did not take it.
settings.collapseFallback: Also shrink the panel a few seconds after the last click
settings.collapseFallbackText: The panel shrinks to one line as soon as you click elsewhere. Switch this on if it stays open when it should not.
overlay.notVerifiedTimeout: No report arrived in time, so this is recorded as not verified.
overlay.notVerifiedSessionGone: The agent's session ended before it could report.
overlay.runbookProposal: Update runbook {name} with the corrected sequence?
log.retention: Nothing is ever deleted automatically: entries stay until you delete them.
log.spec: The spec, as it was stored
log.masked: Secret-treated values are stored as a mask, never as a value.
log.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry with its rounds, notes and sends?
log.deleteAllConfirm: Delete every handoff, round, note and send? Your settings are kept, and handoffs still open are not touched. This cannot be undone.
runbooks.empty: No runbook yet. One is written after every verified handoff.
net.zero: Baton's own code makes no network connections in this build: there is one place in it that could, and nothing calls it. The window is drawn by Microsoft Edge WebView2, a part of Windows that makes connections of its own; the manual shows how to see them.
net.declaration: This page is what Baton says about itself. The check is yours to run: the manual has a command that lists every connection of Baton and of everything it starts, and a firewall test for Baton's own programs.
updates.none: This build does not check for updates.
